name: 💃[Disco dance] Trending Emote Dance
desc:
✨Welcome to Trending Emote Dance!

🎶 A dance game with 210+ Emotes to enjoy

🕺 Tap a player to sync and dance together

💎 Found an Emote you like
You can purchase your favorite Emotes and use them in Roblox!
All emote form Roblox Marketplace 🛍️

⭐ Thank you for playing Trending Emote Dance!
We’ll keep updating the game and doing our best

❤️ Have fun dancing with your friends!

llm.loop: browse 210+ emotes -> dance and sync with other players -> buy favourite emotes from the Marketplace
llm.objectives: dance with friends using trending emotes
llm.instructions: use 210+ emotes, tap a player to sync dances, buy emotes you like for use across Roblox
unique: monetizes via Roblox Marketplace emote sales instead of passes or products
monetization_signals: Marketplace emote purchases (no passes or products)
llm.thumbnails: anime-style girl icon with EMOTE text; avatars dancing on a plain baseplate; emote name text
llm.complexity_notes: flat baseplate showroom with emote list UI and sync script
